title: Singular negative yes/no questions
summary: Form enkö, etkö, and eikö questions followed by ole.
objectives: Attach -kö to the singular negative verb.
Distinguish negative questions from negative statements.

sections.title: The suffix moves to the negative verb
paragraphs: In a negative question, the question suffix attaches to the negative verb. The singular forms are enkö, etkö, and eikö.
The main verb remains ole and follows the explicit subject.

sections.title: Build the complete question
paragraphs: Use negative question verb + subject + ole + context: Etkö sinä ole kotona?
The form asks whether a negative statement is true. It does not change the agreement rule.

examples.english: Is he or she not at work?

commonMistakes: Attach -kö to the negative verb, not to ole.
Do not use affirmative question forms in a negative question.
